author: ORDEM
title: ORDEM hiring artists for character collections
content:
ORDEM is looking for artists to help bring the next worlds, characters, and ideas to life.

Artist? Keep reading
Not an artist? Tag your favourite artist below!

We’re opening opportunities for artists to create collections through ORDEM, with:

- A guaranteed minimum artist payout
- A share of primary mint proceeds
- Potential secondary royalty participation
- Have your work selected, produced, and launched through the ORDEM ecosystem
- Exposure to a community ready to discover what you create of collectors, Guardians, artists and other creators within the ecosystem

We’re not looking for one particular style.

Illustration. 3D. Digital. Traditional. Experimental. Dark. Beautiful. Strange.

If you have a body of work and an idea you believe deserves to exist, we want to see it.

DM us or join the ORDEM Discord and reach out to the team.

Your next world could start here.
